## Specific task description

Task instruction: Stack the three the smooth bowl with glossy finish one above the other.

Task description: Stack the three blue glossy bowls on the table into one pile; two are currently on the left and one on the right.

Success criteria: Stack the three bowls with adjacent bodies approximately overlapping in both horizontal directions. The lowest bowl rests on the table, and the upper two sit low enough to form a short, compact stack. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- Choose a section of the bowl mouth wall facing open space, with one finger inside and one outside gripping its edge. Seat pads on the wall below the rim and match the opening to thickness and approach clearance to reduce sweeping into neighboring bowls.
- Confirm the fingers actually lie inside and outside the bowl wall before closing rather than merely overlapping in the image. Smooth walls can slip; check grasp security with a small lift before transfer.
- Keep the bowl opening facing up during transport. Lift until the base clears nearby bowl rims before moving laterally, reducing collisions, tilting, or slipping.
- Leave adjustment room above the lower bowl opening during stacking, align the upper bottom inside it, then lower slowly. If one side contacts the rim first and tilts, lift slightly and correct rather than pushing horizontally and moving the entire stack.
- Watch clearance between the outer finger and lower bowl rim during lowering, avoiding trapping the finger between bowls. Confirm reliable support before releasing and avoid hooking the rim or lifting the upper bowl while withdrawing.
